comparison_rows.pm_current: Plans define sandboxed inline visual module cards and host-mediated resize, but not a full PM-native streaming marker/feed protocol.
comparison_rows.risk: Do not copy parent DOM scraping or allow-same-origin dependency into PM.
comparison_rows.upstream_v2: visualize(title) mounts an empty iframe; model streams HTML/SVG between @@@VIZ-START and @@@VIZ-END; same-origin observer tails parent chat DOM and renders token-by-token.

comparison_rows.pm_current: PM denies allow-same-origin, allow-forms, allow-popups, and allow-top-navigation; postMessage is the only allowed bridge.
comparison_rows.risk: Same-origin escalation would violate current PM canon and weaken isolation.
comparison_rows.upstream_v2: Requires Open WebUI iframe Sandbox Allow Same Origin; with it, visualization JS can reach the parent page.

comparison_rows.pm_current: sendPrompt, openLink, copyToClipboard, requestResize, question-flow narrowing, local visual-state queues.
comparison_rows.risk: Raw parent.localStorage must not become PM state authority.
comparison_rows.upstream_v2: sendPrompt, openLink, copyText, toast, saveState, loadState.

comparison_rows.pm_current: Minimal PM visualizer theme tokens are locked; hardcoded replacement colors are prohibited.
comparison_rows.risk: Must align with PM design system and Rust/Slint host styling, not copy Open WebUI CSS wholesale.
comparison_rows.upstream_v2: 9 color ramps, data-accent, pre-styled bare HTML controls, aria-invalid and focus-visible defaults, SVG utilities.

comparison_rows.pm_current: Default allowlist is empty; libraries require bundled, version-pinned, integrity-recorded, license/security-reviewed entries; CDN fetches and dynamic network imports are prohibited.
comparison_rows.risk: V2 library list is useful as candidate coverage, not as permission to load remote scripts.
comparison_rows.upstream_v2: Skill documents CDN usage for Chart.js, D3, Vega-Lite, ECharts, Plotly, vis-network, Tone.js/Wavesurfer; strict CSP allowlists CDN script hosts.

comparison_rows.pm_current: PM does not yet spell out incremental visual-stream reconciliation details.
comparison_rows.risk: Without these, streaming visual modules can flicker, remount, lose chart canvases, or capture false markers.
comparison_rows.upstream_v2: Safe-cut parser, append-only reconciler, script serialization, script-populated container preservation, TreeWalker exclusions for tool/reasoning/code details, guarded observers and poll fallback.

comparison_rows.pm_current: PM visualizer plans do not yet specify visualizer-specific localized feedback or audio behavior.
comparison_rows.risk: Audio should be opt-in or off by default unless Jared explicitly wants it.
comparison_rows.upstream_v2: 46-language localization for loader/unavailable/copied/ready/download strings, ready toast, optional chime valve.

high_level_result: PM already has a stronger static/sandboxed inline visual module contract than a naive v1 import, but upstream v2 adds live streaming, richer bridges, pre-styled primitives, a larger visual design system, localization, robust incremental reconciliation, and a broader library catalog. Literal adoption conflicts with PM security because upstream v2 requires allow-same-origin and parent DOM access, while PM plans deny allow-same-origin and require postMessage-only cross-boundary communication.
recommended_direction: Keep Open WebUI v2 as source-lineage/reference-only.
Adopt the live streaming user experience as a PM-native host-fed visual stream if Jared wants it.
Do not adopt same-origin parent DOM scanning; PM should parse model stream/events in the host and feed sanitized fragments to the iframe through a controlled channel.
Expand PM bridge/design-system/library requirements only after resolving persistence, bridge naming, library allowlist, and audio/notification defaults.
title: Open WebUI inline-visualizer-v2 comparison against PM inline visual module plans
